title: Antarctic Ice Marathon — Event page
claims: The race is held in the interior of Antarctica at Union Glacier, not on King George Island outside the Antarctic Circle.
Underfoot conditions are snow and ice throughout; the average windchill is about -20 °C; katabatic winds can blow at 10–25 knots; the event is at about 700 m altitude.
No penguins live this far south and there are no crowds cheering on the route.
The event is a member of the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races and is recognised by Guinness World Records as the southernmost marathon on Earth.
The race was initially operated at Patriot Hills and moved to Union Glacier in 2010; there have been 20 Antarctic Ice Marathon races to date.
The current event page lists the men's marathon record as 2:53:33 (Sean Tobin, 2022) and the women's marathon record as 3:29:16 (Liesl Muehlhauser, 2024).
